prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: Share the Red Truck
irony: Black hogs the red truck to keep all the fun, but a truck with no friend is no fun, so sharing the truck brings the fun back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun fills the street while Black shines his little red truck.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black hugs the red truck, dares Navy and Jade away, and plans a solo ride.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Navy asks for one turn and Jade grabs the pull rope while Black shouts mine.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids circle the red truck chanting the hook as the wheels spin.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black piles blocks too high on the truck and the load tips over.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black sits alone in the piled blocks while Navy and Jade clap nearby.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids circle the red truck again chanting the same hook.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lilac watches the sad truck and owns her strict rules for them all.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lilac sets one kind new rule that the red truck takes turns.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The kids chant the hook as Lilac sings the turned sharing line.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The kids chant the hook, recall the sunny street, and take joyful turns pushing.
